title: Add to Dock in Safari
label: Mac · Safari · Add to Dock

compatibility.note: Owner uses macOS Golden Gate 27.0.1 / Safari 27.0.1. Apple documents Add to Dock on macOS 14 or newer; automatic selection begins at Safari 27, while earlier combinations remain available by manual choice.

evidence.note: Schematic artwork based on Apple documentation, not device screenshots.

steps.title: Open the File menu
steps.description: Open the website in Safari. In the menu bar at the top of your Mac screen, click File.

steps.title: Choose Add to Dock
steps.description: In the File menu, click Add to Dock. Safari opens a confirmation dialog for this website.

steps.title: Click Add
steps.description: Keep or edit the app name, then click Add. A web app is saved to your Applications folder and added to the Dock.

intro: Requires macOS Sonoma 14 or later. These illustrations show the File menu route; Safari also offers Add to Dock in its Share menu.

completion.description: Open the new app from your Dock.

illustration.alt: Three Mac Safari steps: open File, choose Add to Dock, then click Add.
